SEER breast cancer data from Han, Van Keilegom, Wang (2026) JASA

Source: R/data.R
breast_data.Rd

Dataset includes 462 women diagnosed with localized or regional breast cancer between 2004 and 2017 from Surveillance Epidemiology and End Results database residing in county code 175 (Union of Iowa, Morgan of Kentucky, and Laurens of Georgia) .

Usage

breast_data

Format

A data.frame with 462 rows and 7 columns:

Time

overall survival time (months since diagnosis).

Delta

censoring indicator: 0 = no event, 1 = event.

Age

age at diagnosis in years.

Size

tumor size (mm).

Surgery

indicator of whether subject had surgery (1) or not (0).

ER

estrogen receptor status (0 = ER-; 1 = ER+).

PR

progesteron receptor status (0 = PR-; 1 = PR+).

References

Han, B., Van Keilegom, I., Wang, X. (2026). Quantile regression for censored data with a cure fraction. Journal of the American Statistical Association, in press.
